technical-summary: Parity gates the 8-session decode step on the cold round only. Later rounds hit the prefix cache to a varying degree, so the number of sessions decoding together per step varies (all 8 on a full hit: ~2x longer steps, ~7x the throughput), which made sess8_ms_per_step mix concurrency levels and report a false +8.7% regression on the CI release (a same-session A/B of 23d0ef44c vs 1e1953270 showed identical cold rounds, 30.39 vs 30.38 ms). Later rounds are recorded as sess8_warm_ms_per_step (informational). v1.17.0 baseline regenerated. bump-radiance: confirm a compare failure with a same-session alternating A/B (old release via release-install) before calling it a regression.
user-summary-candidate: The Flash-Next parity check no longer reports false multi-session decode regressions caused by prefix-cache hits.
